Rui Chen
Head of Investor Relations, NIO Inc.
Good morning and good evening, everyone. Welcome to NIO's Q1 2024 Earnings Conference Call. The company's financial and operating results were published in a press release earlier today and are posted on the company's IR website. On today's call, we have Mr. William Li, Founder, Chairman of the Board, and the Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Steven Feng, Chief Financial Officer, and Mr. Stanley Xu, Senior Vice President of Finance. Before we continue, please be kindly reminded that today's discussion will contain forward-looking statements made under the Safe Harbor Provisions of the U.S. Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Forward-looking statements involve inherent risks and uncertainties. As such, the company's actual results may be materially different from the views expressed today.
Further information regarding risks and uncertainties is included in certain filings of the company with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, and the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited. The company does not assume any obligation to update any forward-looking statements except as required under applicable law. Please also note that NIO's earnings press release and this conference call include discussions of unaudited, non-GAAP, GAAP financial information as well as unaudited, non-GAAP financial measures. Please refer to NIO's press release, which contains a reconciliation of the unaudited, non-GAAP measures to comparable GAAP measures. With that, I will now turn the call over to our CEO, Mr. William Li. William, please go ahead.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Hello, everyone. Thank you for joining NIO's 2024 Q1 earnings call. In Q1, NIO delivered 30,053 premium smart EVs. In Q2, thanks to the launch of all the model year products, unleash of sales capabilities, together with a more flexible sales policy, NIO's deliveries started to pick up month by month. In April, NIO delivered 15,620 vehicles, and in May, 20,544 vehicles. Our market share in the premium BEV segment continued to grow with year-over-year growth far above the segment average. The total deliveries in Q2 is expected to be between 54,000 and 56,000 units, up 129.6%–138.1% year-over-year.
In terms of NIO's financial performance, during model year product transitioning in Q1, the vehicle margin was 9.2%. In the meantime, with the improvements on the utilization of the charging and the swapping facilities and on the profitability of the after sales services, gross loss on the other sales was greatly reduced quarter over quarter. Now, I would like to share with you the recent highlights of our products and the operations. On April 25, the ET7 Executive Edition was launched at Beijing Auto Show. The delivery of this executive sedan has started in late April. With all-round upgrades, the 2024 NIO ET7 batch caters to the needs of business community. It's well-placed to compete with the premium executive models, especially ICE models such as BMW 5 Series, Audi A6, and the Mercedes-Benz E-Class.
In terms of NAD, on April 30, we started to push urban NOP+ to all NT2 users, making it the largest release of its kind, accessible by more than 260,000 users, on over 1.4 million kilometers of highway and open streets, and in 726 cities in China. NOP+ has been an industry leader in terms of its user base and the coverage. During the Labor Day holiday, 48.1% of the total mileage was driven with NOP+, making user journeys safer and more relaxing. Since day one, NIO has developed a clear brand roadmap, starting from the premium segment to build up skills and experience, and then introducing a mass market brand to reach and serve more users. With that, we will be able to make greater contributions to a more sustainable future.
On 15 May, at the International Day of Families, we introduced ONVO, a new brand for the mainstream family market. ONVO is from On Voyage, and its Chinese name, Le Dao, translates into Path to Happiness. On a mission to make family life better, ONVO is committed to bringing products with the ultimate experience, value, and optimal ownership cost. The pre-order of its first product, L60, was started. L60 is a smart electric midsize SUV. The official product launch and the delivery will begin in September. Launch of ONVO has shipped us into higher gears, expanding our reach to a wider user base. As more people are aware of our technologies and the products, we will edge closer to our vision of blue sky coming.
As for the sales and the service networks, so far, NIO has 154 NIO Houses and 388 NIO Spaces, as well as 344 service centers and 64 delivery centers. About the charging and the swapping networks, so far, NIO has 2,472 Power Swap stations worldwide, and has provided over 45 million swaps. Besides, NIO has also installed over 22,000 power chargers and destination chargers. In the meantime, more industry players have joined NIO's charging and swapping network. As of now, we have partnered with Changan, Geely, JAC, Chery, Lotus, GAC, and FAW to jointly expand and standardize the battery swapping network. More investors have taken notice and recognized the value of NIO's charging and swapping business. On 31 May, NIO Power signed a strategic investment agreement of RMB 1.5 billion.
With the support of strategic investors, NIO will be able to further develop its core technologies and expand the network. On May 13, 2024, NIO was named in the Fortune China ESG Impact List. We have continued to show those social responsibilities and lead by example in the ESG domain to further contribute to sustainable development worldwide. Despite the fierce competition, our continuous investment in technologies, products, services, and the community starts to pay off and set us apart from others. NIO's premium brand positioning, industry-leading technologies, and innovative chargeable, swappable, and upgradeable power experience have been recognized by more people. The last dated studies CSN bond. We will continue to speed up software integrations, optimize products and expenses, improve system capabilities and operational efficiency to gain a larger market share.
In the meantime, as the company unfolds its multi-brand strategy and enters a broader market, we expect to bring out more potential for growth. As always, thank you for your support. With that, I will now turn the call over to Steven for Q1's financial details. Over to you, Steven.
Steven Feng
CFO, NIO Inc.
Thank you, William. I will now go over our key financial results for Q1 2024. To keep this brief, I only refer to amounts in RMB today. I encourage listeners to refer to our earnings press release, which is posted online for additional details. Let's begin with revenue. For the quarter, for Q1 2024, total revenues were RMB 9.9 billion, down 10.2% year-over-year, and 42.1% quarter over quarter. 85% of revenue comes from vehicle sales in Q1, totaling RMB 8.4 billion, down 9.1% year-over-year and 45.7% quarter over quarter. The decrease year-over-year was mainly attributed to lower average selling price as a result of user rights adjustments since June 2023, and a decrease in delivered volume.
The decrease quarter-over-quarter was mainly attributed to a 40% decrease in delivered volume, which was affected by seasonal factors. Turning to other sales. Other sales were CNY 1.5 billion, showing a 5.2% increase year-over-year and 8.2% decrease quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year growth was mainly due to the increase in sales of parts, after-sales vehicle services, and the provision of power solutions, which grew with our user base and was partially offset by a decrease in revenue from sales of used cars and auto financing services. The decrease quarter-over-quarter was mainly attributed to a decrease in revenue from sales of used cars. Let's have a look at the gross margin.
Overall gross margin was 4.9%, compared with 1.5% in the same period of last year, at 7.5% in the last quarter. Changes in gross margin were primarily driven by vehicle margins. Vehicle margin was 9.2% in this quarter, compared with 5.1% in Q1 2023 and 11.9% in Q4 2023. The year-over-year increase was mainly due to the decreased material cost per unit in Q1 2024. The quarter-over-quarter decrease was mainly due to lower average selling price as a result of increased promotion during product transitioning, changes in product mix, and partially offset by the decreased material cost per unit. Next, moving on to the operating expenses.
R&D expenses were RMB 2.9 billion, declined 6.9% year-over-year and 27.9% quarter over quarter, which was mainly driven by decreased design and development costs and decreased personnel costs in research and development functions in Q1 2024. SG&A expenses were RMB 3 billion, increased by 22.5% year-over-year and decreased by 24.6% quarter over quarter. The year-over-year increase was mainly due to, first, the increase in personnel costs related to sales functions. Second, the increase in expenses related to the company's sales and services network expansion. Third, the increase in sales and marketing activities. The quarter over quarter decrease was mainly due to, first, the decrease in sales and marketing activities and professional services.
Second, the decrease in personnel costs related to sales and general corporate functions. Now, we proceed to the bottom line. Loss from operations was RMB 5.4 billion, which is an increase of 1.5% year-over-year and a decrease of 18.6% quarter over quarter. Net loss was RMB 5.2 billion, representing an increase of 9.4% year-over-year and a decrease of 3.4% quarter over quarter. Finally, our balance of cash and cash equivalents, restricted cash, short-term investments, and long-term time deposits was RMB 45.3 billion as of 31 March 2024. For more information and details of our first quarter 2024 financial results, please refer to our earnings press release. Now, this concludes our prepared remarks.
I will now turn the call over to the operator to proceed our Q&A session.
Operator
Thank you. If you wish to ask a question, please press star one on your telephone and wait for your name to be announced. If you wish to cancel your request, please press star two. If you're on a speakerphone, please pick up the handset to ask your question. For the benefit of all participants on today's call, please limit yourself to two questions, and if you have additional questions, you can re-enter the queue. Your first question comes from Tim Hsiao from Morgan Stanley. Please go ahead.
Tim Hsiao
Analyst, Morgan Stanley
Hello, everyone. Thanks for taking my questions and congratulations on the good feedback on ONVO and also some strategic direction for NIO Power. I have two questions. The first question is about the gross profit margin because as we remember, the company previously guided vehicle gross profit margin would be back to mid-teens as the strategic focus of NIO brand is profitability and the cash generation. While ONVO would be the one going for volume. However, we saw increasing promotion for NIO brand in April and May, which worked pretty well, actually, and successfully boost the volume. Will management consider to continue this kind of more aggressive promotion on NIO brand for better volume in the upcoming months? And do we need to revise down our vehicle margin expectation? That's my first question.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Thank you, Tim. I will ask Stanley to answer your question. Thanks.
Stanley Xu
VP of Finance, NIO Inc
Hi, Tim. Regarding the margins for NIO. Actually, regarding the gross margin. Actually we upgraded our NT2 product to 22.4 version from March. During the transition period of the model year product change, more promotions were offered to the old models leading to the decrease of our average selling price in Q1. Additionally, more lower margin models like ET5 and ET5T were sold in Q1. All those factors leads to the decrease of our gross margin. As you mentioned, we delivered over 20,000 vehicles to users in May.
With the recovery of sales volume, we will further optimize our product mix and negotiate with our supply chain partners for more cost efficiency in the following months. We expect the vehicle margin will return to double digits in Q2 and continue to improve in Q3 and Q4. Considering the intensifying market competition, we will also be more flexible on sales policy to make sure our market position is secure. Thank you, Tim.
Tim Hsiao
Analyst, Morgan Stanley
Thank you. That's very clear. Thanks for sharing all the details. My second question is about NIO Power. As William just mentioned, I think NIO Power secures the first external strategic investment of $1.5 billion or around $200 million. So, will NIO Power get and accept more funding support from other car makers in the battery swap alliance? And separately, in addition to NIO Power, is there any other tech arms or business units within the group that could follow suit to seek external capital injection and be gradually carved out? Could management team give us some examples? That's my second question. Thank you.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Oh, Tim. The NIO Power on this. Thank you for the question. For the NIO Power, recently, we have just completed the first round of fundraising, and after this round of financing, NIO still has around 90% of equity in NIO Power. NIO Power is now open for the external investors, be it investment from the investors or from the car companies, we are open for that. Of course, for the longer term, we do believe that NIO Power has a financial sustainability because we do have a promising and a positive outlook for that. At the starting stage-
As we need to build up the network for the Power Swap facilities, the upfront investment is relatively heavy. However, we do see a clear roadmap for the profitability with NIO Power. Let me share with you a number. Right now for the break-even point of a single Power Swap station, it's around the 60 swaps per day. If you look at our current Power Swap service, every day on average, we offer around 100,000 Power Swaps. With around 2,000 stations, it means that for each station, on average, they are already providing around 30 swaps per day. For the longer term, we do see a viable roadmap for the sustainability and also the profitability of our Power Swap business.
Not to mention that we can also leverage the revenues contributed by the energy storage and also the flexible battery upgrade of the Power Swap.
Thank you team.
Operator
Thank you. Your next question comes from Ming-Hsun Lee from Bank of America. Please go ahead.
Ming-Hsun Lee
Analyst, Bank of America
Hi, William and the management team. This is Lee from Bank of America. My first question is regarding ONVO brand. Right now, we are close to the end of Q2. Could you give us some guidance regarding on your sales channel expansion and also CapEx, you know, expense related to ONVO brand? And also, could you give us a rough product pipeline for the ONVO brand? Thank you. That's my first question.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Thank you. Thank you, Lee.
[Foreign language]目前的计划是，乐道在九月份交付的时候，我们会有一百个门店，这大概一百个左右的门店会ready。那么，从目前从CapEx的角度来讲，因为乐道的门店它不需要像NIO那样，有NIO House，这样投资比较大，所以总的来说它比较效率还是非常高的，所以每一个门店的投资差不多在RMB 100万到200万之间吧。所以从一个CapEx的角度来讲的话，我们认为这个对整个公司来说不是一个大的压力。
Thank you for your question. Our current plan is that when we start to launch and deliver the first product of ONVO in September this year, we are going to open up around 100 stores in China. CapEx-wise, as ONVO sales stores or point of sales does not come with NIO House, which does not require heavy investment in that case, the overall CapEx will be pretty efficient, around RMB 1 to 2 million per store. It won't be a very heavy burden from the CapEx perspective.
Yeah.
Ming-Hsun Lee
Analyst, Bank of America
Yeah. Sorry. Could you give us a rough
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Yeah.
Ming-Hsun Lee
Analyst, Bank of America
Yeah.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Yeah, yeah.
Ming-Hsun Lee
Analyst, Bank of America
Could you give us a rough product pipeline for ONVO brand? For example, like one model this year and then maybe two models next year? Is it?
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
[Foreign language]那我们现在乐道的首款产品是这个L60，这个是和Model Y compete的一款中型的SUV。那么在明年，这个我们会launch这个第二款车，那么这是一款中大型的适合这个大一些的家庭的这个SUV，我们在明年会launch。当然我们后续的产品都在规划中。总的来说，ONVO不会有太多的产品，但我们在每一款产品方面，我们都希望它的销量能够在细分市场都能达到一个比较高的份额，因为它所在的这个市场，这个二十万级的家庭用车的这个市场，差不多是四百万量的一个市场。那我们认为在这里边我们还是有非常大的一个市场空间的，但我们不会推太多的产品，但每一款产品我们要确保它的竞争优势。
Regarding the ONVO product pipeline, actually the first product, L60, it will be directly competing with Model Y. It's a mid-size SUV for family users. The next year, we are going to introduce the second product from ONVO. It will be a mid-large SUV for bigger families. We also have other products in the pipeline, but overall speaking, for ONVO, we will not have many products in its offering. We will be focusing on enhancing the market share and also the sales volume of each product in their respective segment. Overall speaking, the total sales volume for ONVO segment, which is a family car market with a starting price of around CNY 200,000, the total size is around 4 million. We do believe that we have a good opportunity and the room for growth in that segment.
Thank you, Li.
Ming-Hsun Lee
Analyst, Bank of America
Yeah. Thank you, William. My second question is related to your third brand, because we read the news today that the Firefly brand could be launched or shown to the market, probably by the end of this year. Could you also give us some latest update on the third brand? Last time during the earnings call, you mentioned that probably Firefly brand product could be sold in NIO House or NIO Space. Could you confirm on this network sharing? Thank you.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
[Foreign language]谢谢。Firefly 目前我们研发的进展总体上都是比较顺利的，那么这个产品，这个车在几个月前其实我就已经开过了，应该说表现非常的好，我非常喜欢。那它的定位的话，在中国的这个定位的话，是这个精品的小车。虽然它的价格是十几万的人民币，但它本身是一款按照非常高的标准，安全标准和这个 quality 标准设计的一款 boutique 的小车。所以，我们从目前的方向的角度来讲，在中国会和 NIO 去 share 这个同样的销售网络，这个就和 MINI 和 smart，MINI 和 BMW 的关系差不多。当然我们的车应该不会卖得比 MINI 贵了，但我们的产品肯定比它好。这个车在明年上半年会正式交付，但发布的时间的话，我们还没有最后决定。但总的来说，交付的角度来讲，肯定在明年的上半年早些时候。
Thank you for the question. Regarding our third brand, Firefly, the R&D activities are in good progress. Several months ago, I've already tried one of the early builds of their first model and it's pretty good. Regarding the Firefly product in the Chinese market, it will be a boutique compact vehicle. Although its price segment is around 100,000 to 200,000 RMB, but it will follow a very high standard for the safety and the quality. It will be a well-designed boutique car for the Chinese market. In terms of the sales channel, it will also share the points of sale with NIO, just like how MINI is sharing its dealerships with BMW. We will be using the similar approach. However, the selling price of Firefly will not be as expensive as MINI.
Product-wise, it is definitely a very good product. We will start the product delivery from H1 next year. Brand launch and product launch, we don't have the specific date for that, but the delivery date is already more or less defined. That is H1 next year.
Thank you William. Thank you. Thank you Ming.
Operator
Thank you. Your next question comes from Bin Wang from Deutsche Bank. Please go ahead.
Bin Wang
Analyst, Deutsche Bank
Thank you. My question is about the margin, because you will migrate to the NT 3.0 this year. As you own a NIO brand product, which migrate from NT 2.0 to 3.0, how much margin improve we can achieve through a technology upgrade? At the same time, based on the NT 3.0 technology, can you provide a volume assumption to reach the overall company break- NT 3.0even? That's my first question. Thank you.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
[Foreign language]谢谢王斌。那当然，我们NIO的产品的话呢，要从明年开始，从ET9开始，开始逐步切换到第三代平台。当然从第三代平台总体上来说，我们当然希望要一个比较好的毛利率，这其中很大一部分是从采用更多的自研的这样的一些技术，比如说芯片啊，那这当然就能显著地提高我们的毛利率。那当然还有一些的话呢，我们也看到了一些，比如说这个电池成本下降的空间啊。所以总的来说，我们从 NT 3.0的一个毛利率的设计目标来讲的话，我们是平均毛利率肯定是希望能达到20%以上的，这当然是我们一个目标，我们对这个还是非常有信心的。那我们的目标，就是说三万量的规模，20%的毛利率在中国的核心业务能够，NIO本身能够盈利，啊，这个我们仍然保持这样的一个经营的目标。对于ONVO的话呢，当然ONVO它本身来说，我们现在公布了一个预售价，这当然不是我们最终的定价了。那从目前的预售价的角度来讲，我们当然还是能有一个非常不错的毛利率。那当然，你们也知道，这个在ONVO所在的一个区间，肯定竞争是非常的激烈的，但我们不会去牺牲这个，我们不会用特别低的毛利去换这个销量，这不是我们的一个方向的方法。我们认为ONVO从长期来说，保持一个15%以上的毛利率，这当然是我们一个经营的目标，啊。如果我们和Tesla去看的话呢，今天它的毛利率差不多也在十六七左右，所以我们在ONVO的角度来讲，肯定是要去追求15%以上的一个毛利，这目前是我们一个目标。啊，从盈亏平衡的角度来讲，ONVO自己大概两到三万辆一个月就能够做到盈亏平衡。
Oh, thank you for the question. Regarding NIO brand, starting from next year, we will gradually upgrade our products to the third generation, and the first product on NT 3.0 will be ET9. For the third generation products, we will also take different approaches to improve the vehicle margin. For example, we will start to put more in-house technologies into our vehicles, like chips, for better vehicle margin performance. We also see some opportunities with the battery cost reduction. Overall speaking, our target for the NT 3.0 product margin will be around the 20%, on average. We do have a confidence of realizing that average margin of 20% from NT 3.0. Regarding the break-even target for the NIO brand, our target is still the same. That is to realize the monthly sales volume of 30,000 units with a vehicle margin of around 20%.
Then we will be breaking even with the core business of the NIO brand in China. Regarding our second brand, ONVO, we have announced the pre-sale price during the brand launch, but we haven't released the final price yet. Even with the pre-sale price, we can realize a pretty good vehicle margin. Of course, we also understand that the competition in ONVO segment is more intense than NIO. In that case, we will also strike a balance between the volume and the margin. We will not boost the sales volume at a cost of our vehicle margin. For the longer term, our target for ONVO products, our margin target for ONVO products will also be around or even above 15%. Because looking at Tesla, their current product margin is around 16% to 17%.
For ONVO, realizing a margin of above 15% is also a reasonable and achievable target for us in the longer term. For ONVO brand, to break even its monthly sales volume should be at least 20,000 to 30,000 units per month.
Bin Wang
Analyst, Deutsche Bank
Thank you. My second question is about the order backlog for ONVO. You actually in interview said that you are very satisfied about the ONVO initial order backlog. The same market talk is that you only have 60,000 cancelable order right now. Can you comment on the number and how satisfied you are about ONVO order so far? Thank you.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
[Foreign language]对，你也知道我们是从来不公布这个预订单的数量的，这个因为预订单是可以随时可以退的，我们不认为有太大的参考意义。但我们确实ONVO的订单的数量超过我们的预期，这个……
[Foreign language]我们ONVO的总裁在采访的时候也说到这一点了，但是我们确实不会去公布这个预订单的数量，我们只能说现在在我们一个店都还没有开的情况下，已经有这样的一个，已经有一个超过我们预期的预订单，这是目前我们可以沟通。
As you know that for us, we never disclose any pre-order intake or numbers as the pre-orders are refundable, and we don't think it's a very solid reference for us to look at the actual performance of the product. However, it is true that with the pre-order intake, it has surpassed our expectation. As also mentioned by the president of ONVO, Alan Ai, in some interviews. Overall speaking, without opening up any stores or having products to the market, we have already received the pre-orders that beyond our expectations. That's the information we can share.
Bin Wang
Analyst, Deutsche Bank
Thank you very much. Thank you.
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
Thank you. Thank you, Bin.
Operator
Thank you. Your next question comes from Paul Gong from UBS. Please go ahead.
Paul Gong
Analyst, UBS
Thanks for taking my questions. Two questions. The first question is, you mentioned that right now you have 2,400 swap stations. To my best understanding, only the third generation and latest battery swap stations could help ONVO to swap the batteries. Could you please remind us how many units of the later generation battery swap stations could help for the ONVO swap?
William Li
Founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO, NIO Inc.
[Foreign language]我们三代站的话，要经过一些改造，但这个改造的工作量当然不会很大了，大概是几十万人民币的一个投资吧，大概二三十万人民币，差不多二三十万人民币的投资，改造了以后就可以给乐道用。然后我们三代站是超过一千座的，所以三代站本身就超过一千座。我们从六月份开始，就是应该在下周吧，我们就开始正式地部署我们的四代站。那么四代站当然就是它上来就是可以兼容这个乐道和这个ONVO和NIO的品牌。当然这个我们今年还会根据整个市场的计划去看我们到底需要部署多少换电站，但是所有的四代站当然都是可以给到乐道用的。所以今年如果看这个目前的一个进展的点来讲的话，我认为到年底的话，能够给乐道用户用的站肯定是超过一千座的，肯定是会超过不少。
Thank you for the question. For our third-generation Power Swap Station to be compatible with ONVO products, we do need to make some necessary modification. It is not a very expensive one, CNY 200,000 to 300,000 per station for the modification. So far, we have already installed more than 1,000 third-generation Power Swap Stations, so that will be a base. In the meantime, not in June, actually next week, we will start to install our fourth-generation Power Swap Stations, and these stations will be compatible with both ONVO and the NIO products. Later this year, depending on the markets and the demand, we will also see and decide how many fourth-generation stations we need to deploy for NIO and ONVO products. All fourth-generation stations can be accessed by ONVO products.
Probably with that, by end of the year, in the market, there will be more than 1,000 stations that can be compatible with ONVO products.
[Foreign language]当然我们不一——我们也不会把所有的三代站都改造，这个因为也不是每座站都需要改造。所以，总的来说，我们，因为乐道的用户一上来也还是没有那么多嘛，所以从一个用户体验的角度来讲的话，那肯定它的用户体验还是非常好。
Of course, it doesn't mean that we will modify or open up all the fourth-generation stations to ONVO users, as not every station needs to be modified or opened up to the second brand. Not to mention that to start with, ONVO will not have a very big user base for the current year. In that case, the experience of both brands will be pretty good.
